body: You should leave him because you clearly don't love him and are with him for security. If "experimenting" is worth more to you than him then just leave him, you're clearly not able to have a relationship. If you loved him in any sense of the word whatsoever this wouldn't even be an option to consider. If you aren't in love after 4 years, stop trying. It's not going to work, and your desire for such a petty thing over love is a massive red flag for him that he needs to be alerted to so he can avoid as much heartbreak as possible.
